notes: Addresses now sit on one line. On a phone each property is a card: address, then town, units and distance, then asking price, maximum offer and verdict with labels.
Dollar boxes show a dollar sign and commas once you leave the box, for example $165,000 or $1,755.78. You can still type plain numbers.
Owned properties are laid out as cards: value, debt, equity and monthly figure up top, then one line per loan with its rate, balance and payment.
New checkbox, “I live here”, keeps your own home out of rental income. Its card shows what it costs each month instead.
Tidier Review filters, and messages next to the Add button now clear themselves.
Fixed: number boxes now accept any amount, including cents. Before, a payment like 1755.78 or a price like 549,900 was rejected with “Enter a valid value”.
Fixed: the screen no longer zooms in when you tap a field, and number boxes open the number keypad.

Owned properties can now carry several loans: mortgage, HELOC, second mortgage, home equity loan, private note or other. Each has its own balance, interest rate and monthly payment. Debt, equity and net income add them all up.
274 more listings across 17 towns in New Hampshire and Massachusetts, out to 74 miles from Dracut.
The Review tab now shows only properties worth a look (Buy box and Negotiate). Choose “everything” to see the ones marked Pass.
When nothing falls inside your chosen distance, the Review tab now says how many properties are farther out instead of looking empty.
Search distance: on the Review tab, choose how far from Dracut to look (10, 25, 50, 75 or 100 miles, or any distance). The app remembers your choice.
Each property now shows its distance from Dracut. The count tells you how many more are waiting beyond your current distance.
Widening the distance shows listings that have already been loaded. Ask Claude to load towns farther out to fill the wider circle.
Four tabs: To review, In flight, Owned, and Archive. The app opens on To review, and each tab shows a count.
To review: open a property and tap Keep to move it to In flight, or Remove and pick a reason to archive it.
In flight: each deal has a stage (Interested, Inquired, Toured, Offer made, Under contract). Mark as bought moves it to Owned.
Owned: enter each property's value, mortgage balance, rent and costs to see equity and net rental income, with totals. These figures stay on your device.
Archive: removed properties and lost deals with the reason and date. Move one back to review, or delete it for good.
New DealDesk logo, and an app icon for your phone's home screen.
The page now always uses the light theme, even when your phone is in dark mode.
On a phone, the pipeline now shows the four columns that decide a deal (property, asking price, maximum offer, verdict) with no sideways scrolling. Tap a deal for the rest.
First release. Scores rental deals against your buy box and works each one back to a maximum offer.
Starts with 16 listings from Manchester and Nashua, NH.
Works on your phone. New listings added to the repo show up the next time you open the page.
